name: kinase insert domain receptor
pathways: positive regulation of nitric oxide-cGMP mediated signal transduction
positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: KDR encodes vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 2. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine kinase activity and transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase activity. It participates in positive regulation of nitric oxide-cGMP mediated signal transduction and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to pulmonary arterial hypertension (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Angiosarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
